top_choice_rationale: P002 keeps the citation on the discovery chain: Holst's human incretin effect, Drucker's proglucagon-derived peptide biology and therapeutic rationale, and Mojsov's characterization of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide. The result is mature and confirmed in independent randomized trials, and one citation covers three names without merging discovery and drug design. P001 is a close second and defensible, since Knudsen's protraction put the therapy into patients, but it ties the prize to an industrial product step; Mojsov's priority against the Habener group stays unsettled in the record. Any award beats no award.
